description: Clamp a nonnegative request to the available capacity.

methods.name: Clamp
methods.header:
method Clamp(req: int, cap: int) returns (grant: int)
  requires req >= 0 && cap >= 0
  ensures grant == (if req <= cap then req else cap)

reference.Clamp: if req > cap { grant := cap; } else { grant := req; }

mutants.violation: Ignoring cap allows grant=12 when cap=8.

provenance: Locally authored quota-domain diagnostic. Not a public/industrial PSM, independent external source, or held-out benchmark.
